_about: M1-ART-02 post-import rules for procedural vegetation (game/core/import/vegetation_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). Materials and LOD ranges are VegetationPlant's defaults; a VegetationPlant on the instance still overrides both at runtime. Plants carry no collision of their own (trunks are HalunaCollision's cylinders); a -col proxy, if one is ever exported, becomes a convex body.
